Various Locations Pavement Renovation No. 82 and Sewer Replacement Rebid – Contract Award
items.text: Various Locations Pavement Renovation No. 82 and Sewer Replacement Rebid – Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Adopt findings pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (“CEQA”) regarding the Final Mitigated Negative Declaration issued by the Planning Department on September 17, 2010 (Case No. 2007.138E) (“FMND”) and adopt a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program (“MMRP”) associated with the Better Streets Plan; approve Director’s recommendation to award San Francisco Public Works Construction Contract Various Locations Pavement Renovation No. 82 and Sewer Replacement Rebid (Sourcing ID No. 0000011684) contract to Ronan Construction, Inc. in the amount of $5,182,475 with $518,247 for contingency, and with 470 consecutive calendar days with 47 consecutive calendar days of contingency to perform pavement resurfacing, curb ramp upgrades, traffic control improvements, sewer improvements and other associated infrastructure work on specified streets in San Francisco. On April 23, 2025, the Planning Department determined the sewer replacement to be statutorily exempt from CEQA under California Public Resources Code Section 21080.21 and CEQA Guidelines Section 15282(k) as described in the determination contained in the Commission files for this project.

items.title: Trash Can Sensor Monitoring System – Professional Services Contract Award
items.text: Trash Can Sensor Monitoring System – Professional Services Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award a professional services contract for Sourcing Event ID 10146 - Request for Proposals for the Trash Can Sensor Monitoring System in the amount of $929,900 for 1,095 consecutive calendar days to Sensoneo, Inc. to supply, install, activate, monitor, and maintain 3,000 trash can sensors to be installed in City trash cans.

items.title: Pier 96 Crane Demolition – Contract Award
items.text: Pier 96 Crane Demolition – Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award construction contract for Pier 96 Crane Demolition to Silverado Contractors, Inc. in the amount of $4,500,000 with a contingency of $450,000 and a term of 270 consecutive calendar days with a contingency of 27 consecutive calendar days. On June 4, 2021, the Planning Department determined that the work to be performed under the contract is exempt from CEQA as a Class 1 categorical exemption ( CEQA Guidelines Section 15301) as described in the determination contained in the Commission’s files for this contract.

items.title: City Hall Façade Hazard Survey – Sole Source Contract Award
items.text: City Hall Façade Hazard Survey – Sole Source Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award sole source contract in the amount of $1,553,543, with a total contract duration of 420 consecutive calendar days, to Tom Lewis Restoration and Consulting, Inc. to perform facade hazard assessment at City Hall. On June 16, 2026, the Planning Department determined that the activities to be performed under the contract are exempt from CEQA as a Class 1 categorical exemption (CEQA Guidelines Section 15301) as described in the determination contained in the Commission’s files for this contract.
